verified_facts.text: Six Senses Vana is a wellness retreat in Dehradun, India.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every stay at our Six Senses retreat in Dehradun includes full-board accommodation with all meals provided and prepared with guided nutrition

verified_facts.text: The retreat is on Mussoorie Road, Uttarakhand.
The retreat is named after the forest it sits in.
verified_facts.excerpt: Named after the forest we take refuge in, Six Senses Vana aims to protect and nurture, providing space to discover and flourish.

verified_facts.text: Wellness combines Ayurveda, Yoga, Tibetan Medicine and Natural Healing Therapies.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ayurveda, Yoga, Tibetan Medicine, and Natural Healing Therapies combine with a kind-hearted team and personalized support.

verified_facts.text: Every stay includes full-board accommodation with guided nutrition, daily retreat activities, wellness consultation and screening, and daily treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: includes full-board accommodation with all meals provided and prepared with guided nutrition; daily retreat activities such as yoga, meditation, workshops, and functional fitness; wellness consultation and screening; daily treatments

verified_facts.text: Guests can access alumni of the Men-Tsee-Khang for Tibetan Medicine diagnostics and treatment.
verified_facts.excerpt: One of the few places where you can access alumni of the Men-Tsee-Khang for sophisticated diagnostics and treatment methods.

verified_facts.text: Natural Healing Therapies include reflexology, physiotherapy, acupuncture and Raag therapy.
verified_facts.excerpt: Remove energy blocks, improve body alignment, and achieve emotional release: reflexology, physiotherapy, acupuncture, Raag therapy, and more.

verified_facts.text: Programs include Sleep, Detox, Weight Management, Yoga and Ayurveda.
verified_facts.excerpt: Find your flow in the motherland of mantras. Aimed at beginners and improvers, programs are delivered by a unique team of instructors whose individual styles complement and enhance your practice.

verified_facts.text: Breakfast, lunch and dinner are served at Salana.
verified_facts.excerpt: Breakfast, lunch, and dinner are served at Salana, Menus are à la carte and accompanied by a carefully chosen buffet at breakfast and lunch.

verified_facts.text: Ingredients are locally sourced, seasonal, fresh and organic.
verified_facts.excerpt: All ingredients, of course, are locally sourced, seasonal, fresh, and organic.

verified_facts.text: Six Senses Vana is a 21-acre retreat.
verified_facts.excerpt: Over the years, the outside world has crept nearer to our 21-acre retreat, and yet, just inside the boundaries, you enter a different world.

verified_facts.text: The team includes Ayurvedic doctors, Yoga teachers, Tibetan healers, fitness experts, acupuncturists and reflexologists.
verified_facts.excerpt: with an assembly of Ayurvedic doctors, Yoga teachers, Tibetan healers, fitness experts, acupuncturists, reflexologists, inspiring Ayurvedic chefs, and a team of caring therapists

verified_facts.text: Optional extras include Subtle Energies treatments, acupuncture, reflexology and realignment.
verified_facts.excerpt: Boost the impact with optional extras such as Subtle Energies treatments, acupuncture, reflexology, realignment, or a pampering mani-pedi.

verified_facts.text: Guests can tailor their itinerary with a program based on their wellness intention, with diagnostics and expert guidance.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tailor your itinerary by choosing a program based on your wellness intention, with diagnostics and targeted guidance from our experts.
